comments.text:
Hi, Simon.

I'm a Japanese male nurse. Thanks to your great materials I bought before, I got 7.5 in the writing section last month for the first time.

Since I have already achieved more than 7.0 in the listening and reading sections, I only need 7.0 band of speaking now to be a nurse in NZ.

Your tips and advice are to the point so much that I'm sure I will make it soon.

Wish you have a wonderful night and thank you.

From Ken, Japan
